plugins.name: model-salt
plugins.description: Varied results for creative requests that are still exactly what was asked. Before a creative task the model writes a few open choices with numbered options in its reply, then calls Model Salt's hosted server at modelsalt.com, which sends back one option number per choice, drawn from randomness outside the model (hardware and quantum noise). Then it does the request with those options. Only the number of options per choice is sent: not your request, not the options, nothing else from the chat.

metadata.description: Model Salt: varied, faithful results for creative requests
